journeyDay.title: Train
journeyDay.description: Check this train’s delay and observations for the selected day.
journeyDay.timelineDescription: Each row is an observation published by Renfe's feed, shown in local time.
journeyDay.statusDescription.onTime: The train is running within the punctuality margin.
journeyDay.statusDescription.minor: The train is running with a minor delay.
journeyDay.statusDescription.major: The train is running with a major delay.
journeyDay.statusDescription.severe: The train is running with a severe delay.
journeyDay.statusDescription.unknown: There is no estimated delay yet.
journeyDay.trendDescription: The centre line marks the scheduled time: above means late and below means early.
journeyDay.trendGuide: Each column is one observation; the farther it is from the centre line, the larger the deviation.
journeyDay.trendNote: Up to 8 representative points are shown in local time. Labels show minutes against the scheduled time.
journeyDay.stopsDescription: Scheduled, estimated and status information for each stop.
journeyDay.estimatedNote: Estimated time adds the longest delay observed during this journey.
